playlist.video_title: Gradient descent, how neural networks learn
playlist.why: This clip explains the training process, which is essential for you to understand how neural networks learn effectively and improve their performance, paving the way for more advanced concepts in optimization and model evaluation later on.

narration: In this learning path, you will explore the training process of neural networks. Understanding this process is critical as it lays the groundwork for how these models learn from data and improve their performance over time. This knowledge will enable you to comprehend various optimizations and techniques used to enhance model training in future topics.
